hoaxes.title: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon adds a setting that plants a tree for every long answer
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Gemini 4 Carbon scored 59 on Artificial Analysis's index and is going first to selected cyber defenders.

hoaxes.title: Netflix's Lupin Part 4 lets viewers vote on which heist Assane pulls next
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Lupin Part 4 led Netflix's non-English TV chart with 10.8 million views in the week to November 1.

hoaxes.title: Xbox will sell its alligator-shaped Series X-BITE console in stores for $1,999
hoaxes.truth: Made up. The Series X-BITE is a one-off console inside an animatronic alligator, offered only through a sweepstakes.

hoaxes.title: AMD will name its next desktop chip the Ryzen 13.4B after its record quarter
hoaxes.truth: Made up. AMD reported record Q3 revenue of $13.4 billion, with data center sales up 97% to $8.5 billion.
